meta.description: Comprehensive end-to-end analysis of Neuropixels extracellular recordings using SpikeInterface. Covers loading SpikeGLX/Open Ephys/NWB data, preprocessing (filtering, common reference, bad-channel detection, phase shift), drift/motion correction, Kilosort4 and CPU spike sorting, postprocessing, quality metrics computation, and multi-method unit curation (threshold-based, model-based UnitRefine, AI-assisted visual review). Supports Neuropixels 1.0/2.0 probes.

scientific_integrity.detail: Strong emphasis on validation, human oversight, and documentation of thresholds/model provenance; warns automated curation is starting point not verdict

practice_boundaries.detail: Clear scope for Neuropixels analysis; distinguishes from general electrophysiology; emphasizes combining approaches and Phy export for critical experiments

methodological_ground.detail: Based on SpikeInterface, Allen Institute, and IBL best practices; references current literature and validated curation approaches

code_usability.detail: Production-ready with bundled scripts, copy-edit templates, complete pipeline, and detailed workflow guidance covering full analysis chain

functional_suitability.note: Complete Neuropixels pipeline: loading, preprocessing, motion correction, sorting (GPU/CPU), postprocessing, metrics, multi-method curation, export

reliability.note: Excellent guidance with common pitfalls section, drift checks, API changes (folder= not output_folder=), trust_model parameter requirements

performance_context.note: Strong optimization guidance: GPU recommendations, cache_dir for reuse, sparse analysis, batch processing; SKILL.md 413 lines well-structured

agent_usability.note: Outstanding clarity with 8-stage workflow, reference file mapping table, bundled scripts for each stage, copy-edit template, critical-things section

human_usability.note: Natural triggers (Neuropixels, spike sorting, MIMIC, electrophysiology), clear when-to-use, hardware/format support tables

security.note: Excellent security: API keys from environment not hardcode, trust_model=True explicit requirement, model provenance validation, no automatic execution

maintainability.note: Exceptional structure with 9 detailed reference files, bundled scripts, copy-edit template, version guidance, clear module organization

agent_specific.note: Strong composability across SpikeInterface ecosystem; deterministic core with documented stochastic elements; minor: long pipeline could use checkpoint/resume

key_strengths: Outstanding comprehensive coverage of entire Neuropixels analysis pipeline with current SpikeInterface best practices from Allen Institute and IBL
Exceptional security handling: API keys from environment, trust_model=True requirement explicit, model provenance validation emphasized
Excellent pedagogical structure with 9 detailed reference files, critical-things section addressing common mistakes, and reference-file mapping table
Multi-method curation approach (threshold-based, model-based UnitRefine, AI-assisted) with clear guidance on combining approaches and human oversight
Production-ready with bundled scripts for each stage, complete pipeline script, copy-edit template, and hardware/format support tables

recommendations.title: Add checkpoint/resume capability guidance for long pipelines
recommendations.problem: Complete pipeline can run for hours; interruption requires restart without checkpoint mechanism
recommendations.root_cause: Focus on complete execution rather than incremental processing with state persistence
recommendations.fix: Add guidance on saving intermediate outputs (preprocessed recording, sorting results, analyzer) and resuming from any stage using saved artifacts

recommendations.title: Strengthen prominence of human oversight for AI-assisted curation
recommendations.problem: AI-assisted curation could be over-relied upon; human accountability statement present but not prominent
recommendations.root_cause: Balance between demonstrating capability and emphasizing limitations
recommendations.fix: Add prominent callout box in AI_CURATION.md: 'AI curation is a decision-support tool, not a ground truth. Always validate AI assessments against expert criteria and export borderline units to Phy for manual review.'
